Game Overview

In Brainrot Tung Sahur Battle, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a frantic duel between Trallero and Tung Tung. Dodge relentless cannonballs from Bananamonkey launchers in a race against time. Quick reflexes and nimble jumps are your best allies in this exhilarating showdown. Outlast your friend and claim victory as the ultimate jumper in this high-paced frenzy!
